name: jaggx/php-cli-chat
description: A simple terminal chat: an async TCP server and a TUI client, built on AMPHP and Symfony TUI

scripts-descriptions.server: Start the chat server (defaults to 127.0.0.1:1337; pass --host=/--port= after --)
scripts-descriptions.client: Connect a TUI client (defaults to 127.0.0.1:1337; pass --host=/--port= after --)
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run static analysis over src/ and bin/
